title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: Town of Mosman Park Local Government Property, Activities and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2025

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 23, 6 Mar 2026); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Using the footpath for outdoor dining needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and conditions to trade on the footpath.
